source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 41700 San Antonio-New Braunfels, TX: labour index L=0.847, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.804; 47-2111 0.844; 47-2152 0.929; 47-2061 0.808; 49-9021 0.899. L = 0.847; factor = 0.40*0.847 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.94. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: New Braunfels uses the 2021 International Residential Code and 2021 energy code (in force since October 2023), with the 2020 electrical code. Every new house over 500 sq ft needs a foundation and wall-bracing design sealed by a Texas engineer, based on a soil report. The usual single-family lot is about 6,600 sq ft; confirm your exact setbacks on your plat and with the city, because we could not read the setback table. If your lot is in a floodplain, the floor must sit about 2 ft above the 100-year flood level. Water and sewer impact fees from New Braunfels Utilities are large - about $23,000 per house in 2023 - plus a city roadway impact fee. West-side lots may sit over the Edwards Aquifer zones, which can add state environmental rules, and often have rock that is costly to dig.
